meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 当用户要求把某个来源（目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或当前对话）变成技能时，Claude 会从中提炼出可重复的操作步骤、命令和易错点，写出或就地更新 .claude/skills/<名称>/SKILL.md。
howto.when: 当用户说“/learn”“learn this”等命令，或要求把某个目录、网址或刚完成的操作做成技能，或要求改进/更新已有技能时触发。

say.text: 把当前项目目录整理成技能。
say.note: 会扫描目录结构并生成 SKILL.md。

say.text: 把刚才我们在对话里完成的操作存成技能。
say.note: 会从聊天记录抽取流程和踩坑点。

say.text: 更新我现有的部署技能，加入这次的新发现。
say.note: 会保留旧内容，只做针对性改进。

howto.what_en: When asked to turn a source—a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation—into a skill, Claude reads it, distills the repeatable steps, commands, and gotchas, and writes or updates .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says “/learn”, “learn this”, etc., or asks to capture a directory, URL, or current conversation as a skill, or asks to improve/update an existing skill.

say_en.text: Turn this project folder into a skill.
say_en.note: It will scan the layout and distill reusable steps.

say_en.text: Save what we just did in this chat as a skill.
say_en.note: It will pull the workflow and gotchas from the conversation.

say_en.text: Update my existing deployment skill with the new findings.
say_en.note: It will keep the old content and refine in place.
